title: Smoked German Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew filled with the rich flavors of Germany. Perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: Canned beans (such as kidney or pinto)
Tomato paste
ingredients.notes: dissolved in 2 cups of beef broth

instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the smoked sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the canned beans, chopped carrots, and chopped potatoes.
Pour in the dissolved tomato paste and beef broth.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 1 hour, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
